spans.s: नल (I) m. 1. A kind of reed; 2. name of a celebrated king of the Nishādas (See App. II.); 3. name of a monkey-chief in the army of Rāma.
नल (II) n. A lotus.
नाल (I) a. (f. ला) Consisting or made of reeds.
नाल (II) n. 1. A hollow stalk especially that of the lotus, R.vi.13, K.S.vii.89; (in this sense it is also masculine); 2. any tubular vessel of the body; 3. a handle.
नाल (III) m. A canal.
नाल (I) a. (f. ला) Consisting or made of reeds.
नाला f. A hollow stalk especially that of the lotus.
नल-कील m. the knee.
नल-कूबर, -कूवर m. name of a son of Kubera.
नल-कूबर, -कूवर m. name of a son of Kubera.
नल-पट्टिका f. a sort of mat made of reeds.
नल-मीन m. a shrimp or prawn.
नलक n. 1. Any long bone of the body; 2. the radius of the arm.
नलकिनी f. 1. The knee-pan; 2. the leg.
नलिन (I) m. The Indian crane.
नलिन (II) n. 1. A lotus flower; 2. water; 3. the Indigo plant.
नलिनेशय m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
नलिनी f. 1. A lotus plant, न पर्वताग्रे नलिनी प्ररोहति Mrich.iv., Sis.iv.46; 2. an assemblage of lotuses; 3. a pond lull of lotoses, नलिनीं क्षतसेतुबंधनो जलसंघार इवासि विद्रुतः K.S.iv.6.
नलिनी-खंड, -षंड n. an assemblage of lotuses.
नलिनी-खंड, -षंड n. an assemblage of lotuses.
नलिनी-रुह (I) m. an epithet of Brahman (m.).
नलिनी-रुह (II) n. a lotus-stalk.
नल्व m. A measure of distance equal to 400 cubits.
नालंबी f. The lute of Śiva.
नालि f. 1. Any tubular vessel of the body; 2. a hollow stalk, particularly that of the lotus.
नाली f. 1. A measure of time equal to 24 minutes; 2. an instrument for piercing an elephant’s ear; 3. a lotus; 4. a canal.
नालिक (I) m. A buffalo.
नालिक (II) n. 1. A lotus flower; 2. a flute.
नालिका f. 1. The stalk of a lotus; 2. an instrument for piercing an elephant’s ear.
नालीक (I) m. 1. An arrow; 2. a javelin; 3. a lotus; 4. the fibrous stalk of a lotus.
नालीक (II) n. An assemblage of lotus flowers.
नालिकेर m. The cocoanut, अंभोधेर्नालिकेलीरसमिव चुलुकैरुच्चुलुंपंत्यपो ये Mv.v.
नालिकेलि(ली) f. The cocoanut, अंभोधेर्नालिकेलीरसमिव चुलुकैरुच्चुलुंपंत्यपो ये Mv.v.
नालिकेलि(ली) f. The cocoanut, अंभोधेर्नालिकेलीरसमिव चुलुकैरुच्चुलुंपंत्यपो ये Mv.v.
नालीकिनी f. A multitude of lotus flowers.
